prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn escaped_field_parser(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse comma-separated fields where backslash may escape only comma or backslash. Empty fields are retained. Reject a dangling backslash or any other escape. Return decoded fields joined by |.
Visible example: a\,b,c\\d, returns a,b|c\d|; a\q is invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: pub fn escaped_field_parser(input:&str)->Option<String>{let mut o=vec![];let mut b=String::new();let mut e=false;for c in input.chars(){if e{if c!=','&&c!='\\'{return None}b.push(c);e=false}else if c=='\\'{e=true}else if c==','{o.push(b);b=String::new()}else{b.push(c)}}if e{return None}o.push(b);Some(o.join("|"))}
